title: Tailwise Grooming Salon Pass Terms — Unused Value Kept as Expiry Approaches
content:
**Clause.** When a prepaid Tailwise Grooming Salon pass (Express Bath, Bath & Tidy, Full Groom or Spa Groom pass) is cancelled and refunded, the expiry share of the unused value follows the calendar days from the cancellation date to the pass's expiry date: fewer than 30 days keeps 0.5 of it, 30 to fewer than 90 days keeps 0.75 of it, and 90 days or more keeps all of it.

The unused value is the price paid less the value of the used visits; the expiry share acts on that unused value.

**Bands**

| Calendar days from the cancellation date to the expiry date | Share of the unused value kept |
|---|---|
| 0 to 29 | 0.5 (half) |
| 30 to 89 | 0.75 (three quarters) |
| 90 or more | all |

The expiry date is the one on the pass record at the time of cancellation, including any extension already granted.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical pass expiring 31 December, unused value 200.00)**

| Cancellation date | Days to expiry | Unused value kept |
|---|---|---|
| 1 December | 30 | 150.00 |
| 2 December | 29 | 100.00 |
| 2 October | 90 | 200.00 |
| 3 October | 89 | 150.00 |
